title.en: An Act Setting Aside a Sum of Money From the Funds Assigned to Miscellaneous Expenses in the Appropriations for Both Bodies of the Legislature During the Year Nineteen Hundred and Twenty-Six for the Payment of Salaries of Such Temporary and Supplementary Force as May Be Necessary

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, for paying the salaries of the temporary employees and the
supplementary force of both Bodies of the Legislature, during nineteen hundred and twenty-six, the sum of
twenty-six thousand five hundred pesos for the Senate, and forty-six thousand pesos for the House of
Representatives, to be taken from their respective appropriations for miscellaneous expenses, made in the
General Appropriation Act and the Additional Appropriation Act, Numbered Thirty-two hundred and
twenty-seven and Thirty-two hundred and sixty.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, July 30, 1926.
